meta.name: hunt-ssrf
meta.description: Hunting skill for ssrf vulnerabilities. Built from 15 public bug bounty reports including AWS metadata SSRF (HackerOne $25k Analytics PDF, Shopify Exchange $25k, Capital One 106M-record breach, Dropbox/HelloSign $4,913), GCP metadata SSRF (Snapchat $4k), Azure IMDS SSRF (Azure DevOps $15k chain, ChatGPT Custom Actions MSRC), DNS rebinding SSRF (Concrete CMS, GitLab UrlBlocker), gopher-protocol-to-Redis-RCE (Yahoo Mail $15k), link-preview SSRF (Reddit Matrix $6k), and headless-browser PDF-generator SSRF chains. Use when hunting SSRF on any target — OOB Collaborator confirmation mandatory for blind cases.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你系统性地寻找 SSRF 漏洞。它会指导你设置外部检测服务器、测试各种 URL 参数和内部端点，并确认漏洞是否真实存在。
howto.when: 当你需要测试某个目标是否存在 SSRF 漏洞时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个 API 端点是否存在 SSRF 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会指导你设置检测服务器并发送测试请求。

say.text: 检查这个链接预览功能是否容易受到 SSRF 攻击。
say.note: Claude 会针对链接预览功能进行测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you systematically hunt for SSRF vulnerabilities. It guides you through setting up out-of-band detection servers, testing various URL parameters and internal endpoints, and confirming whether a vulnerability is real.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test a target for SSRF vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Help me test this API endpoint for SSRF vulnerabilities.
Check if this link preview feature is vulnerable to SSRF.
say_en.note: Claude will test the link preview functionality.
